notes.title: 1st Patch Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35415150/0480ed72fc24afd8ef6968b872e46c9f5dfe502c.gif

Hello everyone!

We want to thank you so much for all reviews so far, all of them showed us great points to improve and care about the game.

Here are the topics that we change on this update:

Screen Flashes

We apologize for all discomfort caused, that wasn't a known issue before, and we never had cases of sensitive players on playtests.

To fix this problem, the game now has a Warning message at the start and a photosensitivity filter that the player can turn ON or OFF at any point. This filter turns off flash colors and reduces the general color intensity and contrast.

Thank you @[KOR] Hong-Gil-Dong and @cloverdew for showing us this.

Rebalanced gameplay

Some players have considered the gameplay too hard for a casual game. We heard you and we made some changes to give less punishing gameplay:


 Missing hearts will not create "wrong progress" on the background anymore. Your objective is more straightforward, just collect hearts to reveal the image.

 The life cap gets a boost for each level, so the player has more chances to recover track if their reflexes fail.


Thank you @cloverdew and @politediligence for your feedback.

Multiple OS Compatibility

We improve Linux and Mac versions native compatibility, thank you @aukkras to help us out.

At last, we devs are always keeping an eye on your feedback, taking notes and working to make the improvements for you :)

If you want to share any feedback or suggestions, report bugs or problems, feel free open a discussion or join us on discord.

If you are enjoying the game and like it, please consider sharing a review, they are always helpful.

Thank you all!
